variants.headline: Looking back: building project badly behind schedule
variants.sub: Construction of a building project is severely delayed in {colony}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: A building project in the colony was badly behind schedule.

Behind schedule. Badly. A building project has failed the calendar's test, and there is no need to invent a row to make that interesting. Readers can demand responsibility without being promised a new finishing date that exists only because it makes the story feel more complete.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The stewardship of {target} warrants scrutiny against the severe delay. This report does not assign an unreported cause or presume that lateness means the project has been abandoned rather than delayed.
